lines.text: The servant bows down and worships the LORD, saying the LORD has led him to the house of Lot.

problems.problem: Its true detail "not withholding His kindness and faithfulness from his master" isn't in Genesis 24:27 word for word.
Its wrong detail "keeping him safe from robbers" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
